_comment: Copy this file to jobblast.config.json (gitignored) and edit it. Every key is optional - anything you leave out falls back to the built-in default shown here, and the app runs fine with no config file at all. Full documentation: docs/CONFIG.md.

contact._comment: Used for the cover letter PDF letterhead, the AI sign-off name, and the contact address in the outbound HTTP User-Agent. Leave a field empty to omit it.
contact.name: Ada Lovelace

candidate._comment: Language rule for AI-generated cover letters: if the posting is written in one of letterLanguages, the letter is written in that language; otherwise it is written in fallbackLetterLanguage. ISO 639-1 codes. nativeLanguage also selects the date locale on the cover letter PDF.

ai._comment: Which engine writes your cover letters. The whole section is optional: leave it out entirely and JobBlast uses the local `claude` CLI, exactly as it always has. Full reference, including which provider supports AI Scout and the Notion Inbox: docs/CONFIG.md.
ai._alternative_none: No AI at all, zero dependencies: every posting keeps the template cover letter and profile-derived bullets. Everything else (aggregation, scoring, review queue, PDF export, tracker) works normally. Use: "provider": "none"
ai._alternative_codexCli: OpenAI Codex CLI, headless. Supports AI Scout (web search via -c tools.web_search=true) and, if you added a Notion MCP server to ~/.codex/config.toml, the Notion Inbox. Use: "provider": "codex-cli" plus the codexCli block below.
ai._alternative_geminiCli: Google Gemini CLI, headless. Cover letters plus web-search-only AI Scout; no Notion Inbox. Use: "provider": "gemini-cli" plus the geminiCli block below.
ai._alternative_anthropicApi: Anthropic Messages API (metered). Cover letters only. Use: "provider": "anthropic-api" and put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env - never here.
ai._alternative_openaiCompatible: Any OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Mistral, Groq, vLLM...). Cover letters only. Use: "provider": "openai-compatible" and put the key in .env under the name you set in apiKeyEnv.
ai._alternative_ollama: FREE AND FULLY LOCAL: install Ollama, run `ollama pull llama3.1`, then just "provider": "ollama" - baseUrl http://localhost:11434/v1, model llama3.1 and no API key are all filled in for you. "lmstudio" does the same for LM Studio on http://localhost:1234/v1. Anything you set in openaiCompatible below overrides the preset, key by key.

scoring._comment: Weighted-keyword relevance scorer. The rules below are tuned for an embedded / C++ / systems profile - EDIT THEM TO MATCH YOUR PROFILE. Regexes are {pattern, flags} pairs; a title hit is worth double the weight of a description hit.

rules.titleReason: DDS middleware mentioned in the title

rules.reason: Software engineer role (軟體工程師) mentioned

penalties._comment: Negative weights. `reason` may contain a {location} placeholder. These defaults assume a junior candidate based in Europe with no US work authorization - review them.

workAuthorization.pattern: u\.?s\.?\s+citizens?|green\s?card|\bw-?2\b|authorized to work in the (?:u\.?s\.?a?\.?|united states)|us work authorization|(?:unable|not able) to sponsor|no (?:visa |new )?(?:visa )?sponsorship|h-?1b (?:transfer|holders?)|security clearance|\bts\/sci\b|\bus persons?\b

usLocation.reason: ⚠ US location outside the target areas

sources._comment: Turn a source off with "enabled": false. Credentials for France Travail and Adzuna come from .env, not from here.

franceTravail._comment_contractTypes: One or more of cdi/cdd/interim/alternance/stage. Empty = every contract type (this default). "stage" contributes nothing - France Travail has no internship listings.
franceTravail._comment_experienceLevel: null (default) = no filter. "1" moins d'un an, "2" 1 à 3 ans, "3" plus de 3 ans. Unlike scoring's soft senior penalties, this excludes results outright.

jooble._comment: Needs JOOBLE_API_KEY in .env (free key: https://jooble.org/api/about). Skipped with a log line when unset.

careerjet._comment: Needs CAREERJET_API_KEY (a free affiliate id/"affid": https://www.careerjet.com/partners/api/). Skipped with a log line when unset.

greenhouse._comment: Verify a slug returns 200 with real postings before adding it: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<slug>/jobs

remotive._comment: Remotive documents ~4 calls/day; this source makes exactly one per refresh cycle. Do not add queries.

yourator._comment: Taiwan startup board. relevanceFilter is a cheap client-side pre-filter (the API has no keyword search); scoring still does the real work.

relevanceFilter.pattern: (c\+\+|embedded|firmware|linux|backend|software engineer|computer vision|opencv|machine learning|devops|full[- ]?stack|工程師|軟體|嵌入式|韌體|後端|影像|演算法|resear?ch engineer)

job104._comment: 104.com.tw (Taiwan). Disabled by default: its search endpoint sits behind Cloudflare bot protection and currently returns zero jobs, so enabling it only wastes request budget.

aiScout._comment: Headless `claude` CLI agent that searches your claude.ai job connectors plus the live web. Requires the `claude` CLI installed and logged in. Throttled to one run per 24h. List your connectors with `claude mcp list`.

notionInbox._comment: Bridges a Notion database of job postings (fed by e.g. a scheduled claude.ai routine) into the pipeline. Requires the claude.ai Notion connector. Rename `properties` to match your database's own property names.

gmailSync._comment: Reads the last few days of recruiter mail (read-only) and moves matching applications forward: reply -> responded, interview invitation -> interview, rejection -> rejected. The only feature that writes to your tracker on its own, so it is off by default. Requires the claude.ai Gmail connector and `ai.provider` = claude-cli. Turn it on with dryRun true first, read data/gmail-sync-journal.jsonl, then set dryRun false. Rows in status approved/interview/rejected/offer are never touched, and offer is never set automatically.

followUps._comment: When an 'applied' application has gone this many days without a reply, the tracker suggests a follow-up with the e-mail pre-written (template, or AI-personalized if a provider is configured). JobBlast never sends it - you copy it or open it via a mailto link. Suggested again after another afterDays window, capped at 2 suggestions per application.
